findings: The change is a pure number tweak (runSpeed, movingPlatformSpeed in packages/games/template/config.ts). A viewer cannot tell the after clip from the before clip, since before/after shots look the same apart from bot positions. Check why the preview ocr gate failed and make sure it is not caused by this change.
